title: Periplus route cursor with changed anchorage and inland branch
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Periplus sections 1–4 give a compact complete route: Myos Hormos to Berenice after 1800 stadia, Ptolemais after about 4000, Adulis after about 3000, a current Mountain Island anchorage replacing the former Diodorus anchorage because of attacks, and inland branches from Adulis to Coloe and then the Auxumite city. A finite route cursor composes distance, endpoint, historical-versus-current anchorage, and inland cargo direction. A flat list or nearest-landmark reset predicts a different endpoint/anchorage state.

source.source_span: Complete bounded route from Mussel Harbor/Myos Hormos through Berenice and Ptolemais of the Hunts to Adulis, including the old Diodorus anchorage, the current Mountain Island anchorage, and the three-day/five-day inland branch.
source.provenance: The University of Washington Silk Road text identifies the work as an anonymous mid-first-century Greek-speaking merchant account and states that the linked text is the Schoff translation. No manuscript access or target comparison is claimed.

duplicate_screen.checked: IDEA000862/GDT862 landmark capacity stop; Vitruvius and Hero construction cards; route-check landmark/route cursor results.
duplicate_screen.difference: This is a textual itinerary with a persistent route endpoint and a source-written replacement of one anchorage by another. It does not infer a diagram landmark, metric geometry, or a generic transport cargo macro.

component_functions.PORT: creates a named endpoint; a repeated endpoint is a reference to the active cursor unless an explicit branch opens a second cursor.
component_functions.DIST: updates leg distance only; it does not create a new port or convert stadia into days.
component_functions.ANCH: keeps old and current anchorage as two distinct physical locations under one Adulis endpoint.
component_functions.INLAND: opens a branch from the current Adulis cursor and returns to the Adulis market endpoint after the inland description.
component_functions.WHOLE_RESIDUAL: selects SAIL, REPLACE_ANCHORAGE, or BRANCH_INLAND; it cannot silently reset the voyage at each place name.

worked_example: cargo = CARGO_FROM(b2, inland_beyond_Nile, Adulis); return cursor remains Adulis.
constructor.observable_consequence: A complete reading must preserve Adulis while distinguishing its current Mountain Island anchorage from the former Diodorus anchorage, and it must route the ivory branch back through Adulis. A nearest-name reset predicts the old anchorage as current or loses the inland cargo return.
rivals: FLAT_LIST: every place name is an independent record; no route cursor or branch return exists.
STATIC_ANCHORAGE: Adulis always uses Diodorus and ignores the source's attack-conditioned replacement.
constructor.falsifier: Reject if the same endpoint can switch current/old anchorage without an explicit condition, if distance is reused as duration, or if the inland branch changes the sea cursor without a written return. The source does not license exact modern coordinates or a target landmark identity.
constructor.target_binding_limit: No target location, cargo token, or route word is independently identified. This is a source-owned finite relation system only.
